description: This PHP script retrieves DSX log data from a device using a system command, processes the log entries, and outputs them as a JSON array. It includes session validation and is intended for AJAX use to fetch log information.

methods.name: session_start
methods.description: Starts a new session or resumes an existing one.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes an external command to retrieve device logs.

methods.name: fopen
methods.description: Opens a file handle for reading the log file.

methods.name: fgets
methods.description: Reads a line from the log file.

methods.name: feof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the file has been reached.

methods.name: htmlspecialchars
methods.description: Converts special characters to HTML entities for safe output.

methods.name: json_encode
methods.description: Encodes the log array into a JSON string for output.
